text:
Alex: quick async — pushed kernel perf PR (WIP) that changes microbatch slot allocation. bench results look promising but kv eviction needs another pass. plan: run 5 full-canary runs today and iterate.
Maria: nice. can you paste the before/after numbers?
Alex: before p95=42ms, p99=180ms. after p95=36ms, p99=165ms. tail improvement ~8-10% on our short-seq workload. throughput roughly +7% on the batcher bench.
Kai: great. are these with kv cache warm or cold?
Alex: warm for the numbers above. cold-run p95 spikes to ~95ms on first token for some shards.
Zuri: that's the eviction behavior we've seen. are you running the new eviction threshold or the old one?
Alex: using new threshold (evict_after_ms=200). I think we need to shorten that to 100ms for some high-churn workloads.
Oliver: note: lowering eviction increases memory pressure — saw a single OOM in local repro when queue depth hit 6x. include a safety valve.
Alex: agreed. plan to add a soft cap: if mem > 80% skip prefetch and rely more on batching.
ci-bot: CI: kernel-perf-pr #482 check start
ci-bot: CI: kernel-perf-pr #482 build passed, unit tests OK, 1 flaky integration test (kv_prefetch_test) failed — rerunning
ci-bot: CI: kv_prefetch_test rerun passed
Maria: can you drop the minimal repro steps for the OOM? want to try on infra before we flip the flag
Alex: repro: run `./bench --microbatch --slots=64 --kv-warm=false --seq=16` and add `--load=burst:120` for 90s. I can paste logs later.
Zuri: also add the latency histogram from the canary. makes it easier to see the cold-start tail.
Alex: will attach hist. short snippet from logs:
```
slot_alloc: 0.12ms avg
kv_prefetch: 5.4ms avg (cold jitter up to 120ms)
batch_emit: 1.8ms avg
```
Kai: minor nit — batch_emit looks healthy. if kv_prefetch jitter is the culprit we can try smoothing by spreading prefetch across slots instead of all at once.
Oliver: +1 to smoothing. also add a canary tag so we can route 5% traffic to this change in staging.
Alex: will do a 5% canary in staging after one more run. blocker right now: a race in slot reclaim when burst drops (seen in logs, reproducer attached in PR).
Maria: do you need help with the race? I can carve out 2 hrs this afternoon.
Alex: yes please — pinged you on the PR. main fix probably around `slot_reclaim()` order of ops.
sre-bot: Deploy notice: staging cluster will roll nodes 14:30 UTC for infra patches (may affect canaries)
Zuri: heads-up — try to start canary after the node roll completes to avoid noise.
Alex: noted. timeline: finish one more bench run, push small fix for slot_reclaim, request review from Maria, then schedule canary after 14:30 UTC.
Maria: ack. I'll take the review + help with the repro once you push.
Alex: thanks — will update here when PR is ready. :thumbsup:
Oliver: if you want, I can add a brief dashboard widget showing p95/p99 for the canary lane so the oncall can eyeball during rollout.
Alex: that would be super useful. Oliver, can you add it to the staging overview? key metrics: p50/p95/p99, OOM count, mem%.
Oliver: yep — will add it and post link once live.
Alex: ok wrapping. tl;dr: PR pushed, perf up ~7-10% on short-seq warm runs, blocker = slot_reclaim race + kv eviction tuning, next steps bench+xfer to canary after infra roll.
